split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before metaprogramming surface, interop compatibility label, runtime acceptance report, generated artifact, package proof, or public workflow
split_policy.positive_rule: metaprogramming and interop closure rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners
split_policy.provenance_rule: runtime reports, runnable conformance/e2e summaries, package manifests, bridge JSON, runtime-import artifacts, cache snapshots, and generated bridge payloads are provenance-only until a phase owner claims the behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: compatibility, shim, fallback, old-mode, unsupported property behavior combination, unsupported foreign loader topology, public ABI widening, stale acceptance, report-only, and generated-report-only claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
